entries.def:
συν-στοιχέω (Rec. συσ-), -ῶ, 
to stand in the same rank or line (Polyb). Metaphorical, to correspond to: Gal.4.25 (see Lft., in l).†
(AS)

συν-στρατιώτης (Rec. συσ-), -ου, ὁ 
a fellow-soldier (Plat., Xen., al.). Metaphorical, of fellowship in Christian service: Php.2.25, Phm 2 .†
(AS)

συ-στέφω 
[in LXX chiefly for קָשַׁר ;] 
__1. to twist together: with accusative of thing(s), Act.28.3. 
__2. Pass., of persons, to gather themselves together: Mat.17.22 (WH, R, mg.).†
(AS)

συ-στροφή, -ῆς, ἡ
(συστρέφω), [in LXX: Rom.4.19; 13.12 (צָרַר); σ. ποιεῖσθαι, Amo.7.10 (קָשַׁר), etc. ;] 
__1. a twisting together (Plat.). 
__2. a concourse, a riotous gathering (Polyb.): Act.19.40 σ. ποιεῖσθαι (Am, l.with), to make a compact (RV, banded themselves together): Act.23.12.†
(AS)

συν-σχηματιζω (Rec. συσ-), 
(σχῆμα), 
to conform to (Arist.). Pass., to be conformed to, conform oneself to: Rom.12.2, 1Pe.1.14.†
(AS)

Συχάρ
(Ε, Σιχάρ), indecl., ἡ 
Sychar, a town of Samaria: Jhn.4.5.†
(AS)

Συχέμ indecl. (Heb. שְׁכֶם), 
Shechem; 
__1. the son of Hamor (Gen.33.19): Act.7.16 b, Rec. 
__2. A city of Samaria (AV, Sychem; in LXX also sometimes Σίκιμα, -ων, as in FlJ): Act.7.16 a,b.†
(AS)

σφαγή, -ῆς, ἡ
(σφάζω), [in LXX for טָבַח, הֲרֵגָה, etc. ;] 
slaughter: Act.8.32 (LXX); πρόβατα σφαγῆς, Rom.8.36 (LXX); ἡμέρα σφαγῆς, Jas.5.5.†
(AS)

σφάγιον, -ου, τό
(σφαγή), [in LXX: Amo.5.25 (זֶבַח), Ezk.21.10, 15; 21.28 (טֶבַח), Lev.22.23 (נְדָבָה) * ;] 
a victim for slaughter: Act.7.42 (LXX).†
(AS)

σφάζω 
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁחַט ;] 
to slay, slaughter (esp. of victims for sacrifice): ἀρνίον, Rev.5.6, 12; 13.8; of persons, 1Jn.3.12, Rev.5.9; 6.4, 9; 18.24; ἐσφαγμένη εἰς θάνατον (RV, smitten unto death), Rev.13.3 (cf. κατα-σφάζω).†
(AS)
